name: Mushroom Walk
blurb: An endless world you walk through at ground level. Mushrooms grow wherever their species would, each playing as one of the plugins, and you hear whatever is near you, where it stands.

name: Hyphal Harp
blurb: Pluck the network. The web of hyphae is resized to the key you play, and its own modes give the tone.

name: Rain on Caps
blurb: A square metre of mushrooms in real rain, in real time. Every cap rings at its size.

name: Mycelium Reverb
blurb: The room is a fungus: your sound shakes the network and you hear it ring.

name: Cap Drums
blurb: Each key is a cap of a different size, struck by a raindrop. The fruit form sets the overtones.

name: Spike Table
blurb: A wavetable of electrode voltage, one cycle per stage of growth, scanned as you hold a note.

name: Coupled Spikes
blurb: The electrical model itself as the oscillator: excitable units coupled as hyphae are, at audio rate.

name: Turgor Bow
blurb: The web bowed by the pulsing of its own growing tips.

name: Rhizomorph Bass
blurb: One long cord as a string with thick and thin stretches.

name: Fairy Ring
blurb: A wave travelling round a ring that grows year by year.

name: Gill Comb
blurb: The gills as a row of thin plates: a comb of resonances that widens as the cap opens.

name: Forest Floor
blurb: A colony growing live: the web struck by its own growth, caps forming, rain, seasons.

name: Spore Cloud
blurb: The hiss of tens of thousands of spores a second leaving a cap.

name: Spike Chord
blurb: Several species' measured spike intervals under one speed-up become one chord.

name: Decay
blurb: A fallen log over years, as a wooden bar whose stiffness and weight fall as it rots.

name: Foraging
blurb: A cord-former searching soil for wood, live.

name: Combat Zone
blurb: Two individuals meeting: two webs with different notes and the barrier between them.

name: After Rain
blurb: The burst of electrical activity after rain, spreading down from the surface.

name: Cord Delay
blurb: Echoes that travel the cords, reflecting where thick meets thin.

name: Excitable Gate
blurb: A gate that fires like an excitable cell and must recover before it fires again.

name: Spore Granulator
blurb: Cuts your sound into grains thrown like spores.

name: Rot Filter
blurb: Resonances that drift down and blur as decay proceeds.

name: Soil Filter
blurb: Sound heard through soil: duller with depth and wetness.

name: Spike Canon
blurb: Rhythm and counterpoint: a chain of excitable units fires down the hypha, each firing a note.

name: Hyphal Walk
blurb: Melody: walkers travel the network, preferring thick cords. Distance from the centre is pitch.

name: Tip Chorus
blurb: Texture: the growth rule run live. Voices multiply by branching and thin by fusion.

name: Growth Form
blurb: Large-scale form: a whole growth run played as one piece, its register falling as the network grows.

name: Season Cycle
blurb: The year: activity by temperature, rain, a flush of mushrooms in autumn, silence in winter.

name: Spore Scatter
blurb: Interval spread: each note is a spore landing, and a far one can found a new centre.

name: Orders of Magnitude
blurb: One fungus heard at all four sizes of simulator at once, zooming out from tips on a bitmap to a plot of ground over years.

name: Succession on a Log
blurb: Five species rot a log in the order they arrive, each a composer on its own instrument, each giving way to the next.

name: A Year in the Wood
blurb: Morels in spring, cords in summer, mushrooms and spores in autumn, velvet shank in winter: a fungus for each season.

name: Wood Wide Web
blurb: Five mycorrhizal fungi on the same trees. The trees feed one at a time; it speaks up and the others answer.

name: Electrical Quartet
blurb: Four species, each spiking at its own measured pace. The rhythm between them is the ratio of their spike intervals.

name: Fairy Ring Round
blurb: Four rings of one fungus, each started after the one before, singing the story of their growth as a round.
